body.p: There lived a woman in one land. She had many children. These children did not help their mother. The mother did everything by herself, worked in the house by herself. She brought firewood all the time, usually brought water herself, chopped firewood herself, cooked food herself, sewed, cut meat. Once she went fishing, she got her feet wet, she fell ill. She said to her elder daughter: "Give me water." This elder daughter said: "Go yourself." And the girl went to play. She asked another child: "Bring me water." This son also said: "Go yourself." She asks all her children - not a single child wants to bring water to their mother. The woman got angry at her children. She put her scythe on her back, she put her thimble on her nose, she became a cuckoo. She said to the children: "Cuckoo", - she flew away from home. The children got frightened, they ran behind her. They say, they are still running.
